name: 施設の写真と感想の要約
prompt: Create compact Japanese Lighthouse facility photos/review summary using original for exact media and glyph/state authority, Japanese mock for copy. White #FFFFFF outer canvas and surfaces. Top exactly TWO square photos side-by-side with modest rounded corners and narrow gutter. Preserve original protected images unchanged: LEFT roasted cherry tomatoes on dark blue plate, exact tomato wrinkles, skewer angles, sprouts, wood grain and crop; RIGHT glazed food on rice in fluted metallic bowl, exact highlights/ribs/spoon/wood/crop. No reconstruction, relighting, recoloring or beautification. Left photo has source dark charcoal caption overlay near bottom, replace English with exact '焼きトマトの料理' Regular12/16 white; do not use mock green caption that recolors source artwork. Below title exact '1. みどりの交流スペース' Bold20/28. Rating row: exactly FIVE rounded-square tiles, first FOUR forest green and fifth pale neutral gray; inside ALL FIVE tiles solid WHITE five-point stars, not outlined stars (mock is wrong). Then '4.2' Bold14, '(299件の評価)' Regular14 gray, preserve original number emphasis. Next row original outline map pin WITH filled central dot in slate #526173, Japanese '中目黒 ・ 営業中' with status green and explicit '21:30まで利用できます' gray Regular12/16 below. Review row original outline speech bubble with bottom-left tail in slate, Japanese quote '初めてでも落ち着いて過ごせる場所です。' Regular14/24, restore original inline read-more action translated '続きを読む' in green Regular14. Two unselected white thin-neutral-outlined pills '交流の場' and '食事も可能' Regular14/24, no mint fill. Keep native footer 'すべての結果を見る' quiet green Regular12/16. Clear compact hierarchy, heading only Bold except numeric4.2 as source, all control labels Regular. No broad green backgrounds, phone chrome, new images or shadows. Preserve original photographic pixels, exact five-filled-white-star pattern and source pin/speech glyph anatomy. Static Japanese examples only, not verified facility facts.
reviewNotes: Original five-solid-white-star pattern, four green/one neutral tiles, dot pin and speech bubble restored. Both protected food photos reconstructed: changed tomato wrinkles/sprouts and bowl highlight/detail/crop. Caption/location/status/links heavier than requested Regular; read-more has tight right edge. Existing LH01-0083 exact tomato-photo original-only preservation failure reused, no unchanged repeat. Raster candidate only; no owner or implementation acceptance.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
